located_by: Skill named source checkout; installed binary embedded compiled source path gave exact checkout. Only targeted files were searched.

unicode.mechanism: For each Unicode scalar, create virtualKey0 keydown/up; keyboardSetUnicodeString; postToPid. No AXValue write, pasteboard call or fallback in this branch; event creation failure throws.
unicode.pasteboard_selection: Only explicit pasteboard or auto strategy resolution can choose paste; explicit unicode bypasses auto heuristics.
unicode.background: InteractionDelivery.swift:27-54 only direct mode initially activates; background with default restore_focus=false makes no activation request.
unicode.MCP_parameters: main.swift:1229-1269 parses strategy/delivery, passes them directly to InputInjector; background default restore_focus=false.
unicode.evidence_limit: MCP mutation reply re-snapshots AX/screenshot/desktop/virtualCursor; it does not forward Core TextInjectionResult strategy/delivery/cursor fields. On snapshot failure it returns summary only. Request+source and actual AX/registry observations must be kept distinct.

click.use: Native MCP coordinate x/y branch, not regular element_index AXPress path. x/y are global screen coordinates; Sky adapter separately maps screenshot coordinates.
click.source: InputInjection.swift:269-334 creates down/up CGEvents at point and postToPid; main.swift:1094-1137 dispatches coordinate branch.
click.real_cursor: No explicit warp/move/restore in click source. Core reads NSEvent.mouseLocation before/after and computes moved >1pt, but current MCP reply does not forward that ClickResult. Actual before/after desktop state must establish movement.
click.overlay: main.swift calls OverlayCursorController.animate/pulse, conditional on current mode rendering on desktop; overlay moves its own NSPanel frame (OverlayCursorController.swift:56-78,225-254). VirtualCursor.record still stores bounded marks even when off; screenshot/desktop rendering is mode-gated. This is separate from real mouse pointer.

restore.release: DesktopSession.swift:132-138,284-291 releases lock/state; MCP release also hides overlay. Neither restores real cursor or original front application.
restore.consequence: No source guarantee of unchanged cursor and no exposed native MCP restore-position primitive. Preserve actual cursor before/after rather than assuming release restores it.

exclusive_session: DesktopSession.swift:146-180,236-260 rejects mutations if foreground differs from acquisition baseline or cursor distance exceeds24pt; source path is reject, not fallback.
scope: Targeted read-only source/API inventory audit; no MCP desktop/doctor/mutation call, no compile/network/git/settings action.
Installed binary hash and source hashes are recorded, but no rebuild or binary-to-current-checkout attestation was performed. Embedded path confirms source origin, not complete current-byte identity.
Targeted CGUnicode events are automated native input delivery, not a physical keyboard/IME route. Successful posting alone does not prove text binding or first query outcome.
No new test framework, instrumentation or UI algorithm.
